paragraphs.text: Captain Vargus Wrath is an Orc Pirate from Ixalan . He is perhaps the most brazen member of the Brazen Coalition .

As an unaffiliated pirate with his own ship, Vargus had the audacity to assault the Spitfire Bastion , a heavily defended pirate fortress. His attack was quickly routed by Captain Ripley Vance , and Vargus was brought before her for execution. Surprising everyone, Vance offered Vargas a new ship and a place in the Coalition.

Vance believed that any pirate with the guts to attack the Bastion would make a fine ally. Vargus now serves as one of Vance's most trusted captains, eagerly smashing and sinking those who would move against her.
